notes.note: Traced the typed scope through orchestration into both OpenCode transports and the ACP adapter. Verified the source contract for an unsupported allow-once answer, provider-side acknowledgement, mode changes, and eligibility metadata.

Checked offer, answer, persistence, and mode reset in native OpenCode and ACP against the documented distinction between per-tool and session-wide grants. An ACP request without allow-once stays open after an all answer is rejected.
Checked ACP request options and provider replies. Eligible session-wide answers select allow-once and Station alone keeps the grant. The API rejects the scope if allow-once is unavailable.

Reviewed the ACP request and answer delta against the cited claims. Station offers the session-wide answer only with allow-once, keeps an allow-always-only request open when that scope is submitted, and leaves launch configuration, earlier policy decisions, and person-only requests on their existing paths.
